title: The stock market is closed. The token is not.

scenes.narration: It's Saturday. The stock market is closed, and John's Apple token is still trading.
On weekdays, traders can buy or sell the real shares, and that keeps the token near the stock price. On a weekend, they can't.
So the price drifts. When news comes out, the token moves on its own, and on Monday Apple may open somewhere else.
RWA Sonar tracks each token's premium to the real stock, split into hours when the market is open and hours when it is closed.
For this token, the gap stayed small while the market was open. While it was closed, it reached two percent.
If John sells on Saturday, he gets the token's weekend price, whatever Apple does on Monday.
Check the closed-market premium before you trade at odd hours. RWA Sonar dot com.
